title: Replace as Pattern Outline
content: ### **Objective** Substitute Pattern outlines with Internal Lines, establishing the Internal Line as the new Pattern outline. ### **Location** 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008329508/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** ### **Operation** 1. [Create an internal line](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000481707) to be substituted with the Pattern outline. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D Toolbar ▶ ![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115008329508/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png) **Edit Pattern** 3. Click on the Internal Line and the Pattern outline that should be replaced. → The Internal Line and Pattern outline are highlighted in yellow. 4. Right-click on the selected Internal Line or Pattern outline. → A pop-up menu appears. 5. Select the**Replace as Pattern Outline** option. → The selected Pattern outline is replaced with the shape of the Internal Line. → The original Pattern outline appears as a Reference Line.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for replacing pattern outlines with internal lines in the 2D Toolbar of the CLO 3D software.

title: Edit Annotation
content: **List of Contents** Edit Annotation Move Delete **Edit AnnotationYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Qvnyx4D7gM ** \- Move or delete annotations on 2D Patterns. \- 2D Toolbar ▶ ![edit_annotation.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001215807/edit_annotation.png)**Edit Annotation** **Move** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hqOlx4S1EsY ** \- Click and drag the annotation to be moved. **Delete** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QeczvVeJz0c** \- Click on the annotation to be deleted. \- Right-click to access the right-click pop-up menu. \- Select **Delete** option. \- Or, hit the Delete key on the keyboard. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a concise guide on how to edit, move, and delete annotations on 2D Patterns, complete with instructional videos for each action.

title: Import - DXF
content: **List of Contents** Import DXF Import (Add) DXF **Import DXF** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O8BE80_y7Z0 \- CLO is compatible with most of Pattern CAD such as YUKA, Gerber, Lectra, StyleCAD, Optitex, and PAD System in DXF-AAMA and DXF-ASTM file formats. \- Import 2D Patterns to use in CLO. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Import ▶ **DXF (AAMA/ASTM). ** \- Locate the DXF file and select **Open.** \- The Import DXF window will appear. \- **Load Type** : Select either to open or add the DXF file. \- **Scale** : select the unit used to create the Patterns. When the **Auto Scale** option is selected, CLO will detect the unit of the Patterns automatically. \- **Rotation** : select the direction that the Patterns will be rotated to. -**Option** : Check following options as needed: Import Pattern Annotation, Auto-Trace as Internal Lines, Swap Cutting Line and Sewing Line, Auto Distribute, and Optimize All Curve Points. \- Select OK to open the Patterns based on the settings. ** Import (Add) DXF** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mDZ7wFc5Af4 \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select File ▶ Import (Add) ▶ **DXF (AAMA/ASTM). ** \- Locate the DXF file and select **Open.** \- The selected DXF file will be added to the workspace. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a comprehensive guide for importing DXF files into CLO, detailing step-by-step instructions and options to enhance pattern integration from various CAD systems.

title: Edit Line (3D Pattern)
content: **List of Contents** Edit Line (3D Pattern) Edit 3D Line Delete 3D Line Right Click Pop-Up Menu on 3D Line **Edit Line (3D Pattern)** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ZpjX25UuBao \- Select, delete and Edit 3D lines created on draped Garments in the 3D Window. \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021985308/mceclip0.png) **Edit line (3D Line)** tool from the 3D toolbar. ** Edit 3D Line** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=JaqfRrmvwxI \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021985308/mceclip0.png) **Edit Line (3D Line)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Click and drag the point on the 3D Line to make adjustments. **Delete 3D Line** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=K5DyjtZDnxA \- Select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021985308/mceclip0.png) **Edit Line (3D Line)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Click on the 3D Line, then hit the Delete key or the Backspace key on the keyboard to delete. **Right Click Pop-up Menu on 3D Line** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iVlsF--JXgY \- Right-click on the 3D Line to access the pop-up menu and select options as below for desired actions. * **Delete** \- The selected 3D Line will be deleted. * **Cut** \- Cut the Pattern based on the selected 3D Line. \- When a 3D Line is drawn only on one of the symmetric Patterns, only the Pattern with the 3D Line will be cut and the linked editing function will be removed. * **Cut & Sew** \- Cut and Sew the Pattern based on the selected 3D Line. \- When a 3D Line is drawn only on one of the symmetric Patterns, only the Pattern with the 3D Line will be cut and sewn and the linked editing function will be removed. * **(Symmetry) Cut** \- Cut the Pattern based on the selected 3D Line. \- Even if the selected 3D Line is drawn on only one of the Symmetric Patterns, both Symmetric Patterns will be cut and linked editing function will be maintained. * **(Symmetry) Cut & Sew** \- Cut and Sew the Pattern based on the selected 3D Line. \- Even if the selected 3D Line is drawn on only one of the Symmetric Patterns, both Symmetric Patterns will be cut and sewn and linked editing function will be maintained. * **Trace as Internal Shape** \- Trace the selected 3D Line as an Internal Shape. * **Convert to Internal Shape** \- Convert the selected 3D Lines to an Internal Shape. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides essential tools and instructional videos for editing, deleting, and managing 3D lines on draped garments within the 3D window.

title: Edit 3D Pen (Garment) Right-Click Pop-Up Menu
content: ### **Objective** Edit desired 3D Pen lines using the right-click pop-up menu. ### Location 3D Toolbar ▶ ![Edit_Line__3D_Pattern_.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000022028/Edit_Line__3D_Pattern_.png) **Edit 3D Pen (Garment)** ### Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar ▶**![Edit_Line__3D_Pattern_.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000022028/Edit_Line__3D_Pattern_.png) Edit 3D Pen (Garment) ** 2. Right click on the desired 3D Pen line. → The right-click pop-up menu appears. 3. Refer to below table and select an appropriate option. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Delete** | Delete the selected 3D Pen line. **Add Point** | Add a Segment Point to the selected 3D Pen line. **Add Curve Point** | Add a Curve Point to the selected 3D Pen line. **Cut** | Cut the Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. **Cut & Sew** | Cut and sew the Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. **Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern (ver5.0.0)** | Duplicate the selected 3D Pen line to its [Symmetric Pattern](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115000354528-%EB%8F%99%EC%8B%9C-%EC%88%98%EC%A0%95-%ED%8C%A8%ED%84%B4-%EC%84%A4%EC%A0%95). **Symmetric** | **Cut** | Cut the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. **Cut & Sew** | Cut and sew the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern based on the selected 3D Pen line. **Trace as Internal Shape** | Trace the selected 3D Pen line as Internal Shapes on the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern. **Convert to Internal Shape** | Convert the selected 3D Pen line as Internal Shapes on the Pattern and its Symmetric Pattern.
content_description: Learn how to edit 3D Pen lines using the right-click pop-up menu in the 3D Toolbar for precise garment design adjustments.

title: Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline
content: **List of Contents** Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline Use Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline **Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Jzs0vmGlfbU \- Extend or trim the Internal Line to Pattern outline. \- Right-click on the Internal Line and select **Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline** from the pop-up menu. ** Use Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=P6tYVh63hn0 \- Use the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022471348/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022402107/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool to right click on the Internal Line \- Select **Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline** from the pop-up menu. \- The selected Internal Line will extend or trim to the Pattern outline. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions and video tutorials on how to use the "Extend/Trim to Pattern Outline" feature for internal lines in design software.

title: Edit Grading Properties
content: **List of Contents** Grading Properties Select Pattern with Grading Edit Grading Properties **Grading Properties** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yLLRnfMtZs8 ** \- Edit grading rules applied to the selected Pattern. \- Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ **Grading** \- 2D Toolbar ▶ ![grading.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360001205408/grading.png)**Grading** **Select Pattern with Grading** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CEICsAiEHNw ** \- Click on the Pattern outline or point which its grading rule to be edited. \- Selected Pattern outline or point’s grading properties appear in the Property Editor. \- If there is no applied grading rule on the selected Pattern outline or point, an error message appears alerting “No graded size available to edit. **Edit Grading Properties** **YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=CoFhg4umEHo** * **Distance** Edit selected Pattern outline or point’s grading rules. Use the Distance option to assign each Size’s distance apart from its Base Size. * Size All Sizes belong to the applied Size Group appear. X-Axis Shift the Size on X-axis. Y-Axis Shift the Size on Y-axis. * **Offset** Edit selected Pattern outline or point’s grading rules. Use the Offset option to edit distance between each size. * Size All Sizes belong to the applied Size Group appear. X-Axis Shift the Size on X-axis. Y-Axis Shift the Size on Y-axis. All Edit all Offset values at once(ver4.1.0). * **Arrow Key Movement** Assign the distance to be moved when using arrow keys. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on editing grading properties for patterns, featuring detailed instructions, video tutorials, and tools for adjusting size distances and offsets.

title: Duplicate as Mirrored Internal Line
content: ### **Objective** Mirror paste Pattern Outline or Internal Line to compare with original Pattern Outlines before the edit. ** Location** Right Click (On Pattern Outline or Internal Line) ▶ **Duplicate as Mirrored Internal Line** ** Operation** 1. Select the **![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360019459094/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png)Edit Pattern** tool. 2. Follow the path indicated below: Right Click (On Pattern Outline or Internal Line) ▶ **Duplicate as Mirrored Internal Line **** →** A guide appears for you to select a reference line which the selected Pattern Outline or the Internal Line to be mirror based accordingly. 3. Hover the mouse over the reference line. → The reference line turns light blue. → A preview appears where the mirrored Pattern Outline or Internal Line will be duplicated to. 4. Select the desired reference line. → The Pattern Outline or the Internal Line is duplicated based on the selected reference line. → The duplicated Internal Line belongs to the Pattern selected in step 2.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for mirroring a pattern outline or internal line in order to easily compare it with the original before making edits.

title: Create Buttons along Pattern Outline
content: **List of Contents** Create Select Unlink ### **Objective** Create buttons along a Pattern Outline in a constant interval and distance.. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=At0TRXrrVAE **Location ** Main Menu ▶ Materials ▶ Button ▶ **Button** 3D toolbar ▶ **Button** ** Operation** **Create** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Right-click on the outline or internal line of the pattern. → The button/buttonhole creation option window appears along the pattern outline. **※Note:** Hold down the Shift key and left-click on a segment to select multiple. 3. Set each option and click OK. **Type**** ** | Start Position | Repeatedly create a button based on the starting point. ---|---|--- Distribute | Create by aligning buttons at regular intervals between the starting and ending points. **Based on Start**** ** | **Start Position** | Distance | Adjust the distance between the clicked segment and the center of the button. Interval | Adjust the spacing between the pattern outline and the center of the button. Reverse | The starting point of the button and replicated created direction are adjusted in reverse. **Replicate** | Interval | Adjust the distance between the buttons. Number of Buttons/Buttonholes | Adjust the number of buttons. **Distribute** | **Position** | Distance | Adjust the distance between the clicked segment and t he center of the button. Start/End Interval | Adjust the spacing between the pattern outline and the center of the start/end buttons. **Replicate** | Number of Buttons/Buttonholes | Enter the number of buttons/buttonholes to align between the start and end points. → A group button is created. **Select** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Click a button or segment created along the pattern outline. → All grouped buttons are selected. 3. Change the [button properties](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115005617768--Property-Button-Property-Setting-) and [style](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/sections/115000728968-%EB%8B%A8%EC%B6%94-%EC%8A%A4%ED%83%80%EC%9D%BC-%EC%84%A4%EC%A0%95) or [right-click](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/115002227747--Popup-Button-Right-Click-Menus). → Applied to grouped buttons. → Group information is not copied/pasted. **※Note:** * If clicking again on the selected group button, it is able to select a button individually. * Grouped buttons cannot be moved. **Unlink** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location.** ** 2. After right-clicking on a button or segment created along the pattern outline and click **Unlink Buttons/Buttonholes**. **** → The group is unlinked.** **
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide on creating, selecting, and unlinking buttons along a pattern outline with precise control over their positioning and spacing.

title: Internal Ellipse
content: **List of Contents** Create Internal Ellipse Create Internal Ellipse with Entered Values ### **Objective** Create internal ellipses or circles within Patterns. **Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Internal Ellipse** ** **2D Toolbar ▶![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002222408/_______.png) **Internal Ellipse** **Operation** **Create Internal Ellipse** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Internal Ellipse**** **2D Toolbar ▶![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002222408/_______.png) **Internal Ellipse** 2. Click and drag within a Pattern to freehand an ellipse. Hold down the Shift key on the keyboard to create a circle. **※ Note:** * While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Ctrl key on the keyboard to create it by the center point (ver.5.1.0). * While creating the Internal Shape, press down the Shift + Ctrl keys to create a full circle by its center point (ver.5.1.0). 3. Release the mouse to complete the Internal Ellipse or the Internal Circle. **Create Internal Ellipse with Entered Values** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ **Internal Ellipse**** **2D Toolbar ▶![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002222408/_______.png) **Internal Ellipse** 2. Click once within a Pattern. → The Create Ellipse window appears. 3. Enter the desired values. **Diameter** | Set the diameter of the Internal Circle. ---|--- **Radius** | Set the radius of the Internal Circle (ver3.2.0). **![mceclip0.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360054822354/mceclip0.png)**| Link to maintain the width and height ratio. **Circumference** | Set the circumference of the Internal Circle (ver3.2.0). **Position** | **To Outline** | Set the position of the left, right, top, and bottom of the Internal Circles from the Pattern outline (ver2.5.0). **To Center** | Set the position of the center of the Internal Circle from the left, right, top, and bottom of the Pattern outline (ver2.5.0). Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a step-by-step guide for creating internal ellipses and circles within patterns, detailing both freehand and value-based methods.

title: Preview and Select AI Artboards
content: **List of Contents** Preview and Select AI Artboards Add Graphic **Preview and Select AI Artboards YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=z_mFM_ZMyMM ** \- When the AI file imported as a graphic has multiple artboards, preview and select the one in need. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select Materials ▶ Graphics ▶ **Graphic (2D/3D) ** \- Or, select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026562207/mceclip0.png) **Graphic (2D/ 3D)** tool from the 2D or 3D toolbar. ** Add Graphic** * **3D WindowYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dTxhKPBGe9M** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026562207/mceclip0.png) **Graphic (3D Pattern)** tool from the 3D toolbar. \- Choose the AI file to be imported. \- When the selected AI file has multiple artboards, the Preview window appears allowing you to select the desired artboard. \- After the artboard is selected, the Add Graphic window appears, allowing you to adjust the graphic size. * **Width** \- Set the width of the graphic. * **Height** \- Set the height of the graphic. \- Click OK to complete. * **2D WindowYouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=g987UzxeSeA** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026562207/mceclip0.png) **Graphic (2D Pattern)** tool from the 2D toolbar. \- Choose the AI file to be imported. \- When the selected AI file has multiple artboards, the Preview window appears allowing you to select the desired artboard. \- After the artboard is selected, the Add Graphic window appears, allowing you to adjust the graphic size. * **Width** \- Set the width of the graphic. * **Height** \- Set the height of the graphic. * **Outline** \- Locate the graphic by assigning the margin between the Pattern outline and the graphic outline. * **Center** \- Locate the graphic by assigning the distance between the Pattern outline and the center of the graphic. \- Click OK to complete. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: "Explore our comprehensive guide to previewing and selecting AI artboards, importing graphics, and adjusting sizes in both 2D and 3D windows."

title: Copy/Paste Patterns (3D)
content: **Objective** Copy and paste patterns in the 3D window. ## ** **Location Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) ▶ **Copy** or **Paste** ## ** **Operation 1. Select the ![Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115024515248/Toolbar_3D_Select_Move.png) **Select/Move** tool from the 3D toolbar. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right-Click Pop-Up Menu (on Pattern) ▶ **Copy** or **Paste** → A preview of the copied pattern follows the mouse cursor. 3. Click on the desired location in the 3D window to place the duplicated pattern. → The copied pattern is automatically assigned a number. **※ Note:** * To copy and paste more efficiently, select the pattern, press Ctrl+C, then press Ctrl+V or Ctrl+R on the keyboard to copy, paste or mirror paste, respectively. * Copy and paste patterns in the 3D window to another CLO software window (ver3.0.0). This is only available in Windows. * Trims and buttons are also copied and pasted along with Patterns (ver5.0.0.) * In the case of buttons and/or subsidiary materials in the pattern, they cannot be copied and pasted into other programs.
content_description: Learn how to easily copy and paste patterns within the 3D window using the Right-Click Pop-Up Menu and keyboard shortcuts in CLO software.

title: Perpendicular Pattern Corner (ver 6.1)
content: ### **Objective** Adjust pattern corners to be perpendicular in curved patterns such as armholes and the center front rise of the pants. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4ok4V1qfyCw ** Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Pattern** ** **2D Toolbar▶![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000037167/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png)**Edit Pattern** ** Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated. 2. Right-click the point of the corner to be set as perpendicular then select **Perpendicular Pattern Corner** from the right-click menu. → The pop-up window appears. 3. After setting the options, click the OK Button. Length | Input the length of the segment to be perpendicular to the opposite segment. ---|--- Direction | Set the direction as perpendicular. **** **※ Note:** The number of curve points can be increased to maintain the curvature of the original pattern. At this time, [optimize the number of curve points](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/ko/articles/115000527527-%EA%B3%A1%EC%84%A0%EC%A0%90-%EC%B5%9C%EC%A0%81%ED%99%94) as needed.
content_description: Learn how to adjust pattern corners to be perpendicular in curved patterns, enhancing your garment design precision.

title: Copy/Duplicate Graphic Image
content: **List of Contents** Copy/Paste Graphic Image Duplicate Graphic Image ### **Objective** Copy/paste or duplicate graphic images as needed. **Location** Right-click Graphics Pop-up Menu ▶ **Copy**(Ctrl + C), **Paste**(Ctrl + V) / **Duplicate to Symmetric Pattern** **Operation** **Copy/Paste Graphic Image** 1. Select a graphic image with ![____156.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115019288628/____156.png) **Edit Texture** tool or ![____156-1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115019199047/____156-1.png) **Transform Graphic** tool in the 2D window. 2. Place the copied graphic image at a desired location in the 2D window. **Duplicate Graphic Image (ver2.3.0)** 1. Select a graphic image with ![____156.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115019288628/____156.png) **Edit Texture** tool or ![____156-1.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115019199047/____156-1.png) **Transform Graphic****** tool in the 2D window. 2. content_description: This web page provides step-by-step instructions for copying and duplicating graphic images using the Graphics Pop-up Menu in the 2D window.

title: 2D Pattern - Exporting Patterns from Gerber(Gerber Pattern Design)
content: **Objective ** Export patterns as a DXF file from Gerber in order to use them in CLO. ** Operation** 1. Load the pattern to be exported, and click File ▶ **Export**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768368/72.png) 2. Click on the patterns to be exported. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768348/69.png) 3. Upon clicking the pattern, the Export window will open up, as shown below. Set the File Type to Amma (*.dxf) and press the **Options** button on the bottom. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005715787/70.png) 4. Check all the sections and press **OK**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768308/71__1_.png) 5. When a window like the one shown below appears, press **OK** to continue. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768368/72.png) 6. Ensure that there are no irregularities in the exported pattern, and press **Close** to complete the export. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768388/73..png)
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on exporting patterns as DXF files from Gerber for seamless integration into CLO.

title: Layer Clone
content: **Objective** Create an instance of the Pattern in its 3D state while sewing its Pattern outlines and Internal Lines to its instance's Pattern outlines and Internal Lines. Use the function to easily create padded jackets, collars, cuffs and other garments/details made with multiple layers of Patterns. ** Location** Right Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Layer Clone (Over/Under)** ** Operation** 1. Select ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001062748/1.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115001062728/2.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. 2. Select the Patterns to be layer cloned. 3. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Layer Clone (Over)** → The cloned Pattern is placed above the original Pattern. Right Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Layer Clone (Under)** → The cloned Pattern is placed beneath the original Pattern. 4. Activate **Simulation**. → The cloned layer is simulated based on the option selected.
content_description: This webpage serves as a comprehensive guide for utilizing the Layer Clone function to create multi-layered garments like padded jackets and collars in a 3D sewing environment.

Y axis and its Distance to Segment Edge. \- To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on **Extend** option. \- When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. **※****Note:** To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on **Reverse** option. * **Local ** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VEq0vnhazaA \- The Add Perpendicular Internal Line window appears. \- Configure Angle and Length of the Internal Line based on the selected segment and its Distance to Segment Edge. \- To extend the Internal Line to the Pattern outline, please toggle on**Extend** option. \- When the Length value is different from the length when it is extended, the option turns off automatically. **※****Note:** To add the Internal Line opposite from current direction, toggle on **Reverse** option. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides comprehensive instructions and video tutorials for adding perpendicular internal lines in a 2D pattern design, including methods for adding lines from points and lines based on the X and Y axes.

title: Offset Pattern Outline
content: ### **Objective** Extend (ver3.0.0) or retract (ver5.1.0) the Pattern outline while maintaining its original shape. ** Location** Right Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Offset Pattern Outline** ** Operation** 1. With the **![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002199388/1.png)Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115002171407/2.png) **Edit Pattern** tool, select the entire or partial Pattern outline. 2. Follow the indicated guideline below: Right Click Pop-Up Menu ▶ **Offset Pattern Outline ** → The Offset Pattern Outline Window appears. 3. Adjust following options as needed. **Option** | **Description** ---|--- **Direction** **(ver5.1.0)** | **Extend** | Extend Pattern Outlines. **Retract** | Retract Pattern Outlines. ※Note: Only **Distance** can be modified when **Retract** is selected. **Distance ** | Set how much in distance the Pattern outline is extended. **Number of Offsets** | Set the number of offsets to be created. **Total Distance** | Total Distance = Distance x Number of Offsets **Create Internal Line** | Create Internal Lines at where the original Pattern outlines existed. **Side Segment Type** | **Perpendicular** | Extends the Pattern outline perpendicular to the selected Pattern outline. **Extend Side Segments (ver3.0.0)** | Extends the Pattern outline while matching the angles of the segments on either side. **Mirror** **(ver5.0.0)** | Extends the Pattern outline based on the corner angle created with the selected Pattern outline and its adjacent one. ![mirror.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360017517274/mirror.png) **Default Corner** | Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or Pattern. **Right Angled Corner** | Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or Pattern and converting corners to right angles. **Unfilled Corner** | Extends the Pattern outline all around the selected segment or pattern, except for corners. 4. Click **OK**. → The Pattern outlines are offset according to the settings. → Curve points are optimized automatically. (ver 5.2)
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide on how to extend or retract the pattern outline while preserving its original shape using the Offset Pattern Outline feature in Clo3D.

title: 2D Pattern - Exporting Patterns from Yuka(SuperALPHA: Plus Yuka Pattern CAD System)
content: **Objective** Export patterns as a DXF file from Yuka in order to use them in CLO. **※ Note:** **Things to Check Before Exporting Patterns** * Confirm that patterns are closed shapes and all segments are connected. * Patterns must be closed in order to virtualize them in the 3D environment. * Confirm that patterns are not intersecting each other. * If patterns' light blue bounding boxes are intersecting, the overlapped area will not be exported properly. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005715647/60.png) **Operation** **DXF-AAMA Export** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: File ▶ EXPORT ▶ **Set TIIP/AAMA** (exps) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005715667/61.png) 2. In the Set DXF Export window’s Pattern Outer lines only check **Margins (Cutting Lines) only**. Set the CAD type as **Etc.** and press **OK**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005715687/62.png) 3. Follow the indicated guideline below: File ▶ EXPORT ▶**Set TIIP/AAMA** (exp) ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005715707/63.png) 4. In the Export DXF window’s File Type check **AAMA**. After setting whether or not the pattern has any margins in Print Pattern Classification, click the **Entire Area** on the right. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768228/64__1_.png) 5. Press **Reference** on the Designate Export window to set the path to export the DXF and click **OK**. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005715727/65.png) 6. If a warning window saying “There is a warning pattern” pops up, click **OK** first and then check the pattern’s status on the window that appears afterwards. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768248/66.png) 7. If all the patterns appear as “OK” then proceed to click **OK** to finish. If there are any that appear as “NG” find them and fix the problem. Patterns may have problems when outer and sewing lines are swapped. ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/article_attachments/115005768268/67.png)
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for exporting patterns as DXF files from Yuka to CLO, ensuring all necessary checks are performed for successful integration into the 3D environment.

title: 2D Pattern (AI/PDF) Import/Export
content: **List of Contents** Import Adobe (AI/PDF) Import (Add) Adobe (AI/PDF) Export Adobe (PDF) **Objective ** Import Adobe (AI/PDF) formatted patterns into CLO, and export patterns created in CLO as a PDF file. ** Location** **Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ **Adobe (AI/ PDF)** **Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF) ** Main Menu ▶ Import (Add) ▶ **Adobe (AI/ PDF)** **Export Adobe (PDF) ** Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ **Adobe (PDF)** ** Operation** **Import Adobe (AI/ PDF)** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Import ▶ **Adobe (AI/ PDF)** → The Open File window appears. 2. Select the desired file to be imported and click **OK**. → The Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) window appears. 3. Adjust the settings as needed and select **OK**. **※ Note: ****Import Adobe (AI/ PDF) Options** **** **** **Scale** | Select the unit used in AI. ---|--- **Rotation** | Rotate all patterns as importing them. **Option** **(Import as Baseline)** | All shapes encompassed within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as baselines. **Option** **(Import as Internal Shapes)** | All shapes encompassed within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as internal shapes (ver3.1.0). **Option** **(Import as Graphic)** | All shapes/images encompasses within their outer shape (pattern) will be imported as graphics (ver3.1.0). Open shapes with color information will be imported as graphics as well (ver3.1.0). **Import (Add) Adobe (AI/ PDF)** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ Import (Add) ▶**Adobe (AI/ PDF)** → The Open File window appears. 2. As setting Import Adobe (AI/PDF) options, adjust Import (Add) Adobe (AI/PDF) options as needed. **Export Adobe (PDF)** 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu ▶ File ▶ Export ▶ **Adobe (PDF)** → The Save File window appears. 2. Type in the file name and designate the path the file is exported to. → The Export PDF window appears. 3. Adjust Scale and Rotation, and then click **OK**. → The patterns will be exported as a PDF file. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This web page provides a comprehensive guide for importing Adobe (AI/PDF) patterns into CLO and exporting CLO-created patterns as PDF files.

title: Pattern Instruction Lines
content: **List of Contents** Pattern Symbol Create Pattern Symbol Select Pattern Symbol Delete Pattern Symbol **Pattern Symbol YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8-Cm61pkfwQ **\- Create, select, and delete instruction lines on Patterns to guide construction. \- Navigate to the Main Menu and select 2D Pattern ▶ Pattern Annotation ▶ **Pattern Symbol.** \- Select the![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115026530867/mceclip1.png) **Pattern Symbol** tool from the 2D toolbar. ** Create Pattern Symbol** * **Create a Single Pattern Symbol YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mChb7-S3M8s ** \- Hover the mouse over the Pattern outline or Internal Line where the Pattern Symbol should be created. \- The segment is highlighted in light-blue. \- Click on the segment to create the symbol. \- The Place on Fold 1 symbol is created by default. * **Create Multiple Pattern Symbols YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_FuGF_Mh_1g ** \- To create more than one Pattern Symbols on multiple Pattern outlines or Internal Lines, select all desired segments while holding down the Shift key on the keyboard. \- You may also click and drag on the 2D window or use the **Lasso Selection** to select multiple segments. **Select Pattern Symbol YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=yNqtBOvAgRE ** \- Select the Pattern outline or the Internal Line where the Pattern Symbol is created. \- The Pattern Symbol is selected as it’s highlighted in yellow. \- To select all Pattern Symbols, hold down the Ctrl + A keys at the same time. **Delete Pattern Symbol YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-TN28hT_Fu8 ** \- To delete the Pattern Symbol, select and hit the Delete key on the keyboard. \- Or, right click on the Pattern Symbol to be deleted and select **Delete** from the pop-up menu. Go back to the List of Contents

title: Create Multiple Patterns or Internal Shapes and Input Intervals
content: ### **Objective** Designate the number of shapes and input the interval when creating Patterns or Internal Lines. ** Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ Applicable Tools 2D Toolbar ▶ Applicable Tools **※ Note: ** * Applicable tools are as follows: **![Toolbar_2D_Shape_Square.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022049428/Toolbar_2D_Shape_Square.png)Rectangle** tool, **![Toolbar_2D_Shape_Inner_Square.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022049468/Toolbar_2D_Shape_Inner_Square.png)Internal Rectangle** tool, **![Toolbar_2D_Shape_Circle.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021994327/Toolbar_2D_Shape_Circle.png)Ellipse** tool, **![Toolbar_2D_Shape_Inner_Circle.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115022049448/Toolbar_2D_Shape_Inner_Circle.png)Internal Ellipse** tool. ** Operation** 1. Follow the indicated guideline as below: Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Create ▶ Applicable Tools 2D Toolbar ▶ Applicable Tools 2. Click once on the 2D window. → The pop-up window with options to create the selected Pattern or Internal Shape appears. 3. Enter desired values for options below the Replicate category and click **OK**. **Name** | **Description** ---|--- **Number of Shapes** | Set the number of replicated shapes. **Interval** | Set the distance between each Pattern or Internal Shape/Line. **Angle** | Set the direction that the replicated Patterns are placed. → The Patterns or Internal Shapes/Lines are replicated based on the settings.
content_description: This web page provides guidance on creating and customizing Patterns or Internal Lines in 2D design by specifying the number of shapes and their intervals using the designated tools.

title: Add Dart with Fullness (ver 5.2)
content: **Objective** Add fullness to a Pattern while adding a Dart. YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WWwjav-SvdA ** Location** Main Menu ▶ 2D Pattern ▶ Edit ▶ **Edit Pattern** ** **2D Toolbar ▶![Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/360000037167/Toolbar_2D_Pattern_Edit.png)**Edit Pattern** **** **Operation** 1. Select the tool/menu indicated in Location. 2. Right-click on the point where the Dart needs to be created and select **Add Dart with Fullness**. → A reference line extended from the selected point to the mouse cursor appears. 3. Click on a Pattern outline. → The Pattern is divided in half based on the reference line. 4. Select a side or the center to add the Dart. Then, move the mouse cursor the adjust the size of the Dart. → A preview of the adjusted Pattern with the Dart and fullness appears. 5. Move the mouse cursor along the centerline to assign the length of the Dart. → A Dart is added with fullness according to the assigned width and length. **※ Note: **Right-click while setting the width and length of the Dart to input specific values.
content_description: This web page provides a step-by-step guide for adding fullness to a pattern while incorporating a dart using the 2D Pattern editing tools.

title: Clone Pattern with Linked Editing – Instance Pattern
content: **List of Contents** Instance Pattern Apply Instance Pattern **Instance Pattern** \- Duplicate Patterns with the linked editing function to edit them identically at the same time. **Apply Instance Pattern** YouTube Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_Qdwc2mADNI \- Navigate to the 2D toolbar and select the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021849587/mceclip0.png) **Transform Pattern** tool or the ![](https://support.clo3d.com/hc/article_attachments/115021911008/mceclip1.png) **Edit Pattern** tool. \- Right-click on the Pattern to be duplicated and select Clone Pattern with Linked Editing – **Instance Pattern.** \- The duplicated Pattern will follow along with the mouse cursor. \- Click on the 2D window to paste the duplicated Pattern. \- The linked Patterns will be highlighted in yellow-green. \- Since the Patterns are linked, they can be edited simultaneously. Go back to the List of Contents
content_description: This webpage provides a concise guide on using the Instance Pattern feature to duplicate and edit patterns simultaneously in your design projects.
